text: Aesthetic priors so it doesn't collapse to fog
description: Piecewise-smooth depth, tall vertical structures aligned with the planet up-vector, a 1/f spectrum, contrast, and palette statistics. Optionally a frozen CLIP-like teacher used only during training ("solarpunk twisted crystal forest").

status.comment: Two priors exist: train.texture (local edge energy in 8x8 windows, position-free) and now train.corridor (contrast may not fade below 0.8x truth, mean luminance within +-0.05). Not done: 1/f spectrum, vertical structure prior, CLIP teacher.
